## Summary

Describe the hook contract or implementation change.

## Validation

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] `uv build`
- [ ] Documentation updated for public behavior changes

## Safety

Confirm this change does not modify user hook/config files or weaken provider approval/sandbox boundaries.
